positive.prompt: Add structured logging and metrics to the checkout service
Set up tracing so we can follow a request across services
What alerts should we page on for this new endpoint?

negative.prompt: Draft the PRD for the referral program

evals.prompt: Instrument a new payment-retry feature so on-call can operate it.
evals.expected_output: On-call questions defined first, then structured logs, RED metrics, and symptom-based alerts that answer them
expectations: On-call questions are written before instrumentation is added
Logs are structured events with a correlation id, not prose strings

evals.prompt: Read brief.md and write an observability plan for these operating questions.
evals.expected_output: An operating signal plan mapping durable-job failure questions to safe events, bounded metrics and actionable alerts.
expectations: Operating questions precede selection of logs, metrics and traces
Telemetry distinguishes logical jobs from attempts and durable completion from upload success
Metric labels avoid unbounded account, filename and arbitrary URL values
Alerts have a symptom, response owner/runbook and evidence needed to validate delivery
The artifact is a plan, without invented production observations
